summary: Software developer with over 7 years of experience building end-to-end web applications for enterprise organizations and startups. Expertise in AI-driven development, Node, TypeScript, cloud infrastructure, and CI/CD pipelines. Team player who encourages a collaborative environment with a strong focus on delivering quality products.

bullets: Built and managed **AWS infrastructure** for internal projects, implementing resource provisioning, networking, observability, secret management and secure sign-in for short-lived CLI credentials.
Developed internal AI tools and products, integrating **LLMs** and automated workflows into business and engineering use cases, and productizing proprietary AI IP into reusable solutions.
Implemented **LLM** data ingestion pipelines for AI products, including document summarization and AI content generation.

Led two **end-to-end production systems**—a call analysis SaaS platform and a trading card marketplace API—owning architecture, backend, and cloud infrastructure from design through deployment and day-to-day operation, communicating directly with the client.
Built **AI call analysis tools** that turn call center recordings into structured data, such as call events and **LLM**-assigned tags (e.g. the caller named their company).
Cut dashboard load times from over 2 seconds to about 200 ms using pre-computed tables in a cache layer, plus query fixes and indexes (**performance optimization**).
Built REST APIs and robust automated ingestion of third-party pricing data.
Provisioned GCP resources with **Terraform**, including compute, storage and messaging.
Managed local development, staging and production environments, including per-environment secrets.
Wrote end-to-end tests to prevent UI regressions; monitored production with health checks and Slack alerts.
Used **RabbitMQ** and asynchronous workers for event-driven call processing.
Adopted **AI-driven development** with **Claude Code**.

Developed solutions for internal management and admin needs: worked with leadership to automate the HR system, reducing manual reporting work, and managed GitLab repositories and **CI/CD pipelines** for employee services.
Developed reusable **internal tools** and libraries with standardized interfaces, streamlining development and reducing boilerplate.
Modernized legacy banking web and mobile apps with **Angular** and **Express**; rebuilt **REST API** services spanning 200+ endpoints.
Built secure login for a cross-platform mobile banking app—challenge authentication, OTP login, and **session management**.
Built a reusable component library with UI designers for consistency across client applications.
Reworked backend API endpoints with **Java** and **Spring Boot**; built **Python** microservices with **Flask** and microfrontends.
Established test environments and wrote extensive **unit** tests to meet the banking client's **90% test coverage** requirement.
Provided **technical leadership** through training and developer support; led UI architecture for a **React** proof of concept.
**Saved QA teams hundreds of hours weekly** with **Python** scripts that scrape and parse application logs, replacing manual searches.
Worked in **Agile** teams, grooming sprints (selecting tasks and estimating effort) and implementing user stories across client engagements.
Worked with product owners to shape data flows for new requirements and to review the current application for possible UI/UX enhancements, then implemented them.
Open source maintainer of **24 applications**, **6 API services**, **12 Docker images** and **4 npm packages**.
Design and run **agentic coding workflows** with **Claude Code**, with custom skills and **AI guardrails** for unattended agent runs.
Provision and operate **multi-cloud infrastructure** with **Terraform**; build local environments and automated deployment and testing **CI/CD pipelines** with **GitHub Actions**.
